evals.prompt: Run a DAH Cards session on Duolingo. I want to understand the dark side of gamification in a language learning app.
evals.expected_output: A consequence map across multiple harm dimensions (psychological, social, behavioral), a sorting verdict of Ethical/Unsure/Unethical with rationale, and a 'What changed?' reflection surfacing at least one non-obvious insight about gamification mechanics.

evals.prompt: We're about to ship a feature that sends push notifications when a friend completes a workout. Run a DAH Cards ethical audit and tell me if we should ship it.
evals.expected_output: A consequence map for the social workout notification feature covering individual and social harms (anxiety, social comparison, pressure, exclusion), an Ethical/Unsure/Unethical verdict with rationale, and actionable design recommendations tied to the harm findings.

evals.prompt: I just ran a DAH Cards session on our calorie/sleep/step tracking app and found some things that made me uncomfortable. Help me write an ethical manifesto and draft a future design vision for my design team.
evals.expected_output: A personal/team ethical manifesto with specific first-person commitments and refusals (not vague platitudes), and a future design vision with concrete product ideas and honest acknowledgment of current harms. Both should feel grounded rather than abstract.
